packageRules.description: Broad groups first (last matching groupName wins in Renovate)
Specific overrides below (win over broader groups above)

Hold @react-types/* at their last type-only versions (button ~3.15, checkbox ~3.10, grid ~3.3, table ~3.13). Newer minors invert the dependency direction: the type-only packages start depending on the full @react-spectrum/* component packages, which drag in @adobe/react-spectrum and a duplicate react-aria/react-stately copy, splitting the i18n + overlay React contexts. See #5485 and upstream https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10139. Patches within the type-only line stay allowed; minor/major are blocked (and must not automerge). Note that some of these (e.g. @react-types/grid 3.4.0) pull @react-spectrum/provider via a *peerDependency*, so `npm view <pkg> dependencies` looks clean while pnpm still auto-installs the peer — verify with `scripts/check-react-aria-dedupe.mjs` after any install, not by reading the manifest. Drop this rule once Adobe ships type-only @react-types/* again.
Vale minors change rule semantics (native MDX in 3.18, JSX-children scoping in 3.19), so review the bump instead of automerging it

The Claude Code CLI drives the AI review job, and nothing in CI exercises that job on a Renovate PR: claude-review.yml skips pull requests whose author is a Bot. An automerged bump would land unverified and first show up as a red Baseline review on everyone else's PRs, so review this one by hand.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: branchConcurrentLimit: 0 is load-bearing. The vulnerabilityAlerts default carries prConcurrentLimit: 0 but not branchConcurrentLimit, and branchConcurrentLimit inherits prConcurrentLimit only when it is not a number (calcLimit in lib/workers/global/limits.ts). The top level sets it, so the inheritance never fires and security branches would be capped at that number instead of unlimited.

customManagers.description: Vale is a downloaded binary, not an npm dependency, so no native manager sees its pin
The review workflow installs the Claude Code CLI itself, so no native manager sees that pin: the github-actions manager only reads `uses:` lines
